source_refs.note: Topic 6.8 as printed before its first sub-heading (PDF 86-87, printed 82-83); each sub-heading has its own lesson.

blocks.text: Validation is used to check how well a model works on new data. It is done after training and testing to confirm model reliability. It prevents models from memorizing data. Validation supports fair evaluation. Model improvement uses feedback from validation results. Weak areas are identified and corrected. Validation is important before real use.
book_errors: It is done after training and testing
It prevents models from memorizing data.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Two corrections. (1) Validation is not done after testing: in the train, validation and test method the validation set is used after training to tune and compare models, and the test set is used last, once, for the final check; if testing came first, its result would be used for tuning and would no longer show performance on unseen data. (2) Validation does not by itself prevent memorising: it shows whether the model has memorised the training data (overfitting), and tuning the model with its results helps avoid it. So: it is done after training and before the final test, to tune the model and confirm its reliability. It shows whether the model has memorised the training data.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Validation checks how a model works on new data. It prevents overfitting. Model improvement uses tuning and adjustments. Good validation increases reliability. Strong models perform well in real conditions.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Validation does not by itself prevent overfitting: it helps detect it, and tuning the model with its results (the next sentence) helps avoid it. So: validation checks how a model works on new data. It helps detect overfitting, and tuning the model with its results helps avoid it.
